key_verdict: The setter's key is correct in every part and the blind examiner matches it exactly; nothing is in dispute.
fixes: (d)(ii) 'Solve the equation x^2 + 5x - 300 = 0' cannot carry [1]: SEAB awards a factorised quadratic [2] (M1 factorisation, A1 both roots), never a single mark. Give it [2] and let the paper absorb the extra mark at this slot (12), or keep 11 by dropping (b) and re-weighting (c) to [3] as 'Mei sells a cup of latte for $5.94. Calculate the percentage profit ...' (cost of cup [1], profit [1], percentage [1]).
(d)(i) 'show that it simplifies to' -> SEAB's wording is 'show that it reduces to x^2 + 5x - 300 = 0'.
Print the sub-part marks only; the stem line '(d) ... [5]' should carry no mark on the paper.
why: A clean 4052 money-and-ratio question with exam-friendly numbers (3952.34 exact, 5.50, 98%, roots 15 and -20) and the standard 'form an equation and show it reduces to' quadratic, all in register; the one residual weighting fault is the 1-mark solve in (d)(ii), which no GCE paper prints. Not a re-skin of any exemplar (those are pure algebra medleys).
